name: Yordle Jinx
creator: snorr
description:
** Modified skin:**
Base Jinx

I wanted to see how well I am able to translate a humanoid champion into a Yordle version of themselves, I was very inspired by artwork of the artist PTcrow, which I also used as the Loadscreen and Icons in this mod. I think it worked pretty well, the animations were just the most pain to make work.
This skin obviously only works for Base Jinx.
It uses assets from Jinx' wild rift preview model and the 3D resources of the Runeforge Wiki.
Loadscreen and Icon Artwork made by PTcrow

***

If you find issues with this skin feel free to contact me on Discord: Snorr_
